title: Darkness retreat study testing for spikes in natural DMT

tellings.quote: myself and New Nordics, um the group that I work with in Florida, we're funding a study where they're going to

plain: A study planned in Florida in 2025 will test whether people kept in total darkness for days produce a surge of DMT, a powerful psychedelic chemical the body is thought to make in small amounts. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says he and New Nordics, a group he works with in Florida, are paying for the study. If such a surge were found, it would suggest the brain can reach DMT-like states on its own.
